Container.Name: plembfin
Container.Overview: Self-hosted watch history and playstate sync for Plex, Emby, Jellyfin, and Trakt.
Container.Description: Plembfin is now Plekt. Existing installs can keep their current appdata folder and change the image to plembfin/plekt:latest. Plekt keeps watched state, playback progress, watch history, ratings, and the Plex watchlist aligned across connected media services. Open the WebUI to claim a fresh install and complete the guided setup.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: plex trakt plextraktsync emby jellyfin watch history watchstate playstate sync

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Port used by Plembfin's web interface.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent database, configuration, backups, and cached artwork.

Config.Name: PORT
Config.Description: Internal server port matching this legacy template's container port mapping. Keep 5056 unless you also change the container port.

Config.Name: ADMIN_USERNAME
Config.Description: Administrator username. Settings values take precedence after the account is claimed.

Config.Name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Optional initial administrator password. Leave blank to claim the account in the WebUI on first start.
